title: Tensor-unit comparison of derived and raw section cohomology
statement: Let f:X→T be any scheme morphism [def-pc-scheme, def-pc-morphism-conventions], F any module sheaf [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], I an injective resolution [def-sp-injective-resolutions], q≥0, W an arbitrary open of T, and a∈Γ(T,W). Put Y=(f⁻¹W).toScheme, G=F|Y, L=the tensor unit of Y.Modules, b=f♯a as a global function on Y, and s its section of L [def-weil-pbc-ample-invertible-module]. Put K=f_*I and P=sectionCohomologyPresheaf(K,q) [def-weil-pbc-flat-base-change-open-choices]. Give P(D(a)) its Γ(T,W)-action by restriction of scalars. For every open U in Y whose set is nonvanishingLocus(L,s), there exist additive equivalences e:H^q(U,G)≃P(D(a)), c_n:H^q(Y,G⊗L^n)≃P(W), and d_n:H^q(U,G⊗L^n)≃P(D(a)), for all n≥0 [def-sc-open-module-cohomology, def-sc-cohomology-fraction-presentation]. They satisfy d_n(H^q(U,ρ_G⁻¹ followed by G tensor s^n)(z))=a^n e(z), and d_n(res ξ)=res(c_n ξ). This is solely comparison of section complexes, scalar maps and restrictions: it asserts no localization or denominator lifting and requires no affine, qcqs or quasi-coherence hypotheses.

proof.text: Construct unitPowIso recursively, using identity at n=0 and tensoring with the preceding isomorphism followed by the left unitor at n+1. Tensor with G and compose the right unitor to obtain unitTwistIso:G tensor unit^n≅G. The scalar formula is proved by induction: tensorPowSectionOne_succ, tensorHom_app_tmulSection, and the left-unitor formula give b times b^n = b^(n+1) on every open. The right-unitor and tensor-section formulas then identify tensoring by s^n followed by unitTwistIso with multiplication by b^n. These are explicit morphism equalities, including n=0.

proof.text: Define c_n and d_n by applying the top-open and U-open cohomology functors to unitTwistIso and composing their underlying additive equivalences with t and e. Functor.map_comp transports the tensor-section identity through U-cohomology. The untwisted scalar equation for r=a^n and map_pow give the required power equation. Naturality of openModuleCohomologyRestriction for unitTwistIso, followed by the untwisted restriction equation, gives the second equation.

lean.statement:
theorem sectionCohomology_unit_comparisons {X T : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : X ⟶ T) (F : X.Modules) (I : InjectiveResolution F)
    (q : ℕ) (W : T.Opens) (a : Γ(T, W)) :
    let Y := (f ⁻¹ᵁ W).toScheme
    let G := (restrictFunctor (f ⁻¹ᵁ W).ι).obj F
    let L := 𝟙_ Y.Modules
    let b := ((f.app W) ≫ (f ⁻¹ᵁ W).topIso.inv).hom a
    let s : Γ(L, ⊤) := unitSectionsEquiv ⊤ b
    let K := ((pushforward f).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).obj I.cocomplex
    let P := sectionCohomologyPresheaf K q
    let : Module Γ(T, W) (P.obj (op (T.basicOpen a))) :=
      Module.compHom _ (T.presheaf.map (homOfLE (T.basicOpen_le a)).op).hom
    ∀ (U : Y.Opens), (U : Set Y) = nonvanishingLocus L s →
      ∃ e : (RingedSpace.openModuleCohomology Y.toRingedSpace q U).obj G ≃+
          P.obj (op (T.basicOpen a)),
      ∃ c : ∀ n : ℕ,
        (RingedSpace.openModuleCohomology Y.toRingedSpace q ⊤).obj
          (G ⊗ L.tensorPow n : Y.Modules) ≃+ P.obj (op W),
      ∃ d : ∀ n : ℕ,
        (RingedSpace.openModuleCohomology Y.toRingedSpace q U).obj
          (G ⊗ L.tensorPow n : Y.Modules) ≃+ P.obj (op (T.basicOpen a)),
      (∀ (n : ℕ) (z : (RingedSpace.openModuleCohomology Y.toRingedSpace q U).obj G),
        d n ((RingedSpace.openModuleCohomology Y.toRingedSpace q U).map
          (((ρ_ G).inv ≫ G ◁ tensorPowSection (homOfGlobalSection L s) n) :
            G ⟶ (G ⊗ L.tensorPow n : Y.Modules)) z) = a ^ n • e z) ∧
      (∀ (n : ℕ) (ξ : (RingedSpace.openModuleCohomology Y.toRingedSpace q ⊤).obj
          (G ⊗ L.tensorPow n : Y.Modules)),
        d n ((RingedSpace.openModuleCohomologyRestriction Y.toRingedSpace q
          (homOfLE (le_top : U ≤ ⊤))).app (G ⊗ L.tensorPow n : Y.Modules) ξ) =
            (P.map (homOfLE (T.basicOpen_le a)).op).hom (c n ξ))
